# Frappe Framework v15

> Technical documentation of Frappe Framework (v15) for app developers, desk users and AI agents. Verified against the source code of this version.

## Getting Started

- [Installation](getting-started/installation.md): Install the bench CLI, create a bench with Frappe v15, create a site and start the development server.
- [Architecture](getting-started/architecture.md): How a Frappe v15 bench, its sites and apps fit together, how a request is handled, and which processes run beside the web server.
- [Quickstart](getting-started/quickstart.md): Build a small Frappe v15 app end to end with a DocType, a controller validation, a whitelisted method, a form script, a list view setting and a test.
- [Glossary](getting-started/glossary.md): Short definitions of the terms used in the Frappe Framework v15 and its documentation.

## User Guide

### Desk Basics

- [Desk](user-guide/basics/desk.md): Find your way around the Frappe v15 desk at /app - login, navbar, workspace sidebar, workspaces, awesomebar, notifications, user menu and keyboard shortcuts.
- [List View](user-guide/basics/list-view.md): Find, filter, sort and select documents in the Frappe v15 list view, use the group-by sidebar and saved filters, run bulk actions and set list settings.
- [Views](user-guide/basics/views.md): Show the documents of a DocType in Frappe v15 as a report, kanban board, calendar, gantt chart, tree, dashboard, image grid, map or email inbox.
- [Form View](user-guide/basics/form-view.md): Read and change one document in the Frappe v15 desk form - layout, save, submit, cancel and amend, timeline, attachments, sharing, print, email, links, duplicate, rename and form shortcuts.
- [Fields](user-guide/basics/fields.md): Fill each kind of field in a desk form - text, numbers, check boxes, selects, links, dates, child tables, attachments, editors, signature, map, rating, duration, color and phone.
- [Search](user-guide/basics/search.md): Find pages and documents in Frappe v15 with the awesomebar, global search, list filters and tags, and control what global search indexes.
- [Collaboration](user-guide/basics/collaboration.md): Work on documents with other users in Frappe v15 - assignments and ToDo, sharing, comments and mentions, likes, follow, tags, energy points, activity and the notification log.

### Users and Permissions

- [Users and Roles](user-guide/users-and-permissions/users-and-roles.md): Create users, give them roles, group roles with Role Profiles, limit modules with Module Profiles, and set password, login and two-factor rules.
- [Role Permissions](user-guide/users-and-permissions/permissions.md): Set what each role can do on each DocType with the Role Permissions Manager, permission levels, rights and "Only If Creator".
- [User Permissions](user-guide/users-and-permissions/user-permissions.md): Limit a user to specific records with User Permission, including applicable DocTypes, default values, descendants, strict mode and the permitted documents report.

### Customization

- [Customize Form](user-guide/customization/customize-form.md): Change the fields, layout and properties of a standard DocType from the desk with Customize Form, Custom Field and Property Setter.
- [Workflow](user-guide/customization/workflow.md): Move documents through approval states with Workflow, Workflow State, transitions, conditions and Workflow Action.

### Automation and Email

- [Automation](user-guide/automation/automation.md): Assign documents with Assignment Rule, repeat documents with Auto Repeat, set Reminders, track Milestones, and name documents with Document Naming Rule and Document Naming Settings.
- [Notifications](user-guide/automation/notifications.md): Send email, in-app, SMS or Slack alerts when documents change, with the Notification DocType, Notification Log and Notification Settings.
- [Email](user-guide/automation/email.md): Set up Email Account and Email Domain, watch the Email Queue, reuse text with Email Template, schedule Auto Email Report, and handle unsubscribes.

### Data, Reports and Printing

- [Data Import and Export](user-guide/data-and-reports/data-import-export.md): Insert or update many records from CSV, Excel or Google Sheets with Data Import, map columns, read the import log, and export records with Data Export.
- [Reports](user-guide/data-and-reports/reports.md): Build and save Report Builder reports, run Query and Script Reports, use prepared and snapshot reports for slow reports, and export results to Excel or CSV.
- [Dashboards](user-guide/data-and-reports/dashboards.md): Show counts and charts with Number Card and Dashboard Chart, group them in a Dashboard, and add them to workspaces.
- [Printing](user-guide/data-and-reports/printing.md): Print documents, download PDFs made with wkhtmltopdf, and design Print Formats with the Print Format Builder, Jinja HTML or raw commands, plus Letter Head and Print Settings.

### Website and Integrations

- [Website](user-guide/website-and-integrations/website.md): Publish Web Pages, Web Forms, blog posts and newsletters, set up the site header, footer and home page in Website Settings, run the portal for website users, and track visits.
- [Integrations](user-guide/website-and-integrations/integrations.md): Connect a Frappe site to other systems with Webhooks, OAuth clients, Connected Apps, Social Login Keys, LDAP, Google settings, push notifications and Dropbox, Google Drive or S3 backups.

### Settings

- [How Settings Work](user-guide/settings/how-settings-work.md): Settings pages are Single DocTypes stored in tabSingles. Learn where to open them, who can edit them, when a change takes effect, and how to read, write and build them in an app.
- [System Settings](user-guide/settings/system-settings.md): Every field of System Settings, grouped by form tab, with its default, its effect and the server and desk code that reads it.
- [Security, Session Default and Log Settings](user-guide/settings/security-settings.md): Field reference for Security Settings (security.txt), Session Default Settings and Log Settings, with where Frappe reads each field.
- [Desk Settings](user-guide/settings/desk-settings.md): Field reference for Navbar, Global Search, Domain, Document Naming, Energy Point and per-user Notification Settings, with where Frappe reads each field.
- [Website Settings](user-guide/settings/website-settings.md): Field reference for Website Settings, Portal Settings, Contact Us Settings, About Us Settings, Website Script and Blog Settings, with the website code that reads each field.
- [Print Settings](user-guide/settings/print-settings.md): Field reference for Print Settings, with the effect of each field on the print view, PDF generation, letter heads, bulk print and email attachments.
- [Integration Settings](user-guide/settings/integration-settings.md): Field reference for OAuth Provider Settings, LDAP Settings, Push Notification Settings, Google Settings, SMS Settings and the Dropbox, Google Drive and S3 backup settings, with where Frappe reads each field.

### System Administration

- [Backups](user-guide/system-administration/backups.md): Take, download, schedule, encrypt and restore site backups with bench, the Download Backups page, and the Dropbox, Google Drive and S3 backup integrations.
- [Logs and Monitoring](user-guide/system-administration/logs-and-monitoring.md): Find errors and check site health with Error Log, Activity Log, Access Log, Scheduled Job Log, RQ Job, RQ Worker, Recorder, System Health Report, System Console and Log Settings.


## Developer Guide

### Building Apps

- [Apps](developer-guide/building-apps/apps.md): Create a Frappe app, understand its files and folders, install it on a site, and build its assets.
- [Hooks](developer-guide/building-apps/hooks.md): How hooks.py works, how hook values from all apps merge, and the hooks that apps use most.
- [Extending Other Apps](developer-guide/building-apps/extending-apps.md): Change the behavior of DocTypes and methods from another app with doc_events, controller overrides, method overrides, doctype_js, custom fields and property setters.
- [Fixtures and Patches](developer-guide/building-apps/fixtures-and-patches.md): Ship records with an app through the fixtures hook, change data on existing sites with patches, and understand the order of bench migrate.
- [Translations](developer-guide/building-apps/translations.md): Mark strings with _() in Python and __() in JS, use context and lazy strings, keep PO/POT files in an app, and run the bench translation commands.

### Data Model

- [DocTypes](developer-guide/data-model/doctypes.md): The DocType JSON, standard and custom DocTypes, the main DocType properties, child tables, singles, trees and virtual DocTypes.
- [Naming](developer-guide/data-model/naming.md): How Frappe sets the name of a document, with autoname options, naming series, the autoname controller method and rename.
- [Controllers](developer-guide/data-model/controllers.md): The Document class, controller lifecycle methods and their exact run order, doc_events, flags, db_set, change detection and whitelisted controller methods.
- [Files](developer-guide/data-model/files.md): Store and attach files with the File DocType, upload them over HTTP, and choose public or private storage.

### Fields and Controls

- [Field Properties](developer-guide/fields/field-properties.md): How DocField properties behave on the desk and on the server - names, defaults, depends_on rules, fetch_from, constraints, permissions, list and print settings.
- [Text Fields](developer-guide/fields/text-fields.md): How Data, Small Text, Text, Long Text, Text Editor, Markdown Editor, HTML Editor, Code, JSON, Password and Read Only fields store values, behave in the desk and validate on save.
- [Number Fields](developer-guide/fields/number-fields.md): How Int, Float, Currency, Percent, Check, Rating and Duration fields store values, format numbers and currencies, and validate on save.
- [Date and Time Fields](developer-guide/fields/date-and-time-fields.md): How Date, Datetime and Time fields store values, use the System Settings formats, convert between user and system time zones, and work with frappe.datetime and frappe.utils.
- [Link and Select Fields](developer-guide/fields/link-and-select-fields.md): How Link, Dynamic Link, Select and Autocomplete fields store values, search and filter in the desk, and validate on save.
- [Table Fields](developer-guide/fields/table-fields.md): How Table and Table MultiSelect fields store child rows, how the desk grid works, and the Python, JavaScript and REST APIs for rows.
- [Media and Special Fields](developer-guide/fields/media-fields.md): How Attach, Attach Image, Image, Signature, Barcode, Geolocation, Color, Icon and Phone fields store values, behave in the desk and validate on save.
- [Layout and Display Fields](developer-guide/fields/layout-fields.md): How the desk builds a form from Section Break, Column Break, Tab Break and Fold fields, and how Heading, HTML, Button and Attachment Gallery fields work.
- [Controls](developer-guide/fields/controls.md): Use the desk control JavaScript API - control classes, make_control, control methods, FieldGroup and Dialog fields, dialog-only controls, and custom controls from an app.

### Database

- [Database API](developer-guide/database/database.md): Read and write data with frappe.db and frappe.get_list / get_all, the filter syntax, and when Frappe commits or rolls back a transaction.
- [Query Builder](developer-guide/database/query-builder.md): Build SQL queries in Python with frappe.qb (PyPika): DocType tables, conditions, functions, joins, subqueries and frappe.qb.get_query.

### Permissions and Security

- [Permissions](developer-guide/security/permissions.md): How the permission engine decides access from role permissions, permission levels, user permissions, sharing and app hooks, and how to check permissions in code.
- [Authentication](developer-guide/security/authentication.md): Authenticate HTTP requests with a session cookie, API key and secret, or an OAuth 2 bearer token, and how CSRF, two-factor login, guests and auth hooks work.
- [Security](developer-guide/security/security.md): Write secure Frappe app code - permission checks in whitelisted methods, safe SQL, escaping, private files, rate limits, CSRF, secrets and the risks of ignore_permissions.

### Requests and APIs

- [Request Lifecycle](developer-guide/api/request-lifecycle.md): Follow one HTTP request through frappe.app.application in v15, from site resolution, session and auth to dispatch, commit, response, cleanup and errors.
- [Whitelisted Methods](developer-guide/api/whitelisted-methods.md): Expose Python functions over HTTP with @frappe.whitelist, validate arguments with type annotations, restrict access by role, rate limit, and override methods of other apps.
- [REST API](developer-guide/api/rest-api.md): Read and change documents and call whitelisted methods over HTTP with /api/v1 (resource, method) and /api/v2 (document, doctype, method), including list parameters, responses and errors.
- [API Internals](developer-guide/api/api-internals.md): How Frappe v15 routes an /api request to a function, checks whitelist, guest and HTTP method rules, binds arguments, and turns frappe.response into JSON, files, redirects and errors.
- [Customizing APIs](developer-guide/api/customizing-apis.md): Every way a v15 app can add or change API behavior in Frappe, from whitelisted methods and overrides to doc_events, permission hooks, request hooks, auth hooks, CORS, response formats, versioning and tests.

### Jobs, Realtime and Caching

- [Background Jobs](developer-guide/runtime/background-jobs.md): Run code outside the web request with frappe.enqueue and frappe.enqueue_doc, on RQ queues served by bench workers.
- [Scheduler](developer-guide/runtime/scheduler.md): Run functions on a schedule with the scheduler_events hook, Scheduled Job Type records and the bench schedule process.
- [Realtime](developer-guide/runtime/realtime.md): Push events from the server to browsers with publish_realtime, Socket.IO rooms on the Node server, and frappe.realtime.on.
- [Caching](developer-guide/runtime/caching.md): Cache data in Redis with frappe.cache, read documents with get_cached_doc and get_cached_value, and use the request_cache, site_cache and redis_cache decorators.

### Desk UI

- [Form Scripts](developer-guide/desk-ui/form-scripts.md): Add client-side behavior to a desk form with frappe.ui.form.on events, the frm object API and the doctype_js hook.
- [List View Settings](developer-guide/desk-ui/list-view-settings.md): Customize the desk list, tree, calendar and gantt views of a DocType with <doctype>_list.js and the related view settings files and hooks.
- [Client API](developer-guide/desk-ui/client-api.md): Call the server, read data, show messages and dialogs, route, and format values from desk JavaScript with frappe.call, frappe.db, frappe.model, frappe.ui.Dialog and related helpers.
- [Desk Pages](developer-guide/desk-ui/desk-pages.md): Build a custom desk screen with the Page DocType, its JSON, JS, CSS and HTML files, frappe.pages events and frappe.ui.make_app_page.
- [Workspaces](developer-guide/desk-ui/workspaces-sidebar-dock.md): Ship desk navigation from an app with Workspace JSON records, and list the app on the /apps screen with the add_to_apps_screen hook.

### Website and Portal

- [Website](developer-guide/website/website.md): Serve web pages from an app with www/ files, route rules, redirects, base templates, DocTypes with a web view, Blog and Newsletter, page renderers and Jinja hooks.
- [Web Forms](developer-guide/website/web-forms.md): Ship standard Web Forms in an app, add a client script and Python context, control access and list settings, and use Web Form Request keys.

### Reports, Printing and Email

- [Reports](developer-guide/output/reports.md): Build Script Reports and Query Reports in an app, define filters, return charts and summaries, run reports from code, and use prepared reports and report roles.
- [Print Formats](developer-guide/output/print-formats.md): Ship Print Formats in an app, write Jinja print templates, render HTML or PDF with frappe.get_print, and know how wkhtmltopdf, WeasyPrint and the pdf_generator hook make PDFs.
- [Email and Notifications](developer-guide/output/email-and-notifications.md): Send email with frappe.sendmail and the Email Queue, use Email Templates, ship Notifications in an app, log Communications, handle incoming email and create system notifications.

### Server and Client Scripts

- [Server Scripts and Client Scripts](developer-guide/low-code-and-ai/server-and-client-scripts.md): Write Python Server Scripts and JavaScript Client Scripts in the desk, enable server scripts, and know the restricted API that safe_exec allows.

### Testing and Performance

- [Testing](developer-guide/testing-and-performance/testing.md): Write and run tests for Frappe apps with FrappeTestCase, test records, test helpers, run-tests, run-parallel-tests and run-ui-tests.
- [Performance](developer-guide/testing-and-performance/performance.md): Keep Frappe apps fast with indexes, cached reads, fewer queries, bulk operations and background jobs, and find slow code with the Recorder, the monitor log and query profiling.

### Configuration and Operations

- [Configuration](developer-guide/operations/configuration.md): Configure a site with site_config.json and common_site_config.json, read values with frappe.conf, change them with bench set-config, and override them with environment variables.
- [Deployment](developer-guide/operations/deployment.md): Run Frappe in production with the bench CLI - processes, Procfile, supervisor or systemd, nginx, workers and queues, socketio, maintenance mode and DNS multitenancy.
- [Upgrading](developer-guide/operations/upgrading.md): Upgrade a bench to Frappe v15 from v14, what the v15 patches change on a site, deprecation warnings in v15, and what to prepare for v16.


## Reference

### Python API

- [frappe namespace](reference/python/frappe.md): Every public name on the frappe Python module in version 15 with signature, defaults, return value and side effects, grouped by topic.
- [Document](reference/python/document.md): Every public method and property of frappe.model.document.Document in version 15, the hook run order of each operation, behavior flags and the frappe.model helper modules.
- [frappe.db](reference/python/database.md): Every public method and attribute of frappe.db in version 15 with signatures, defaults, return values, side effects and the differences between MariaDB and Postgres.
- [frappe.qb](reference/python/query-builder.md): Reference for frappe.qb and frappe.query_builder in version 15 - tables, fields, terms, functions, Case, Interval, run() options and every argument of frappe.qb.get_query.
- [frappe.utils](reference/python/utils.md): Reference of every public helper in frappe.utils and its most used submodules, with signatures, defaults, return values and side effects.
- [Permissions and Sessions API](reference/python/permissions-and-sessions.md): Signatures and behavior of frappe.permissions, frappe.share, frappe.sessions, frappe.auth, User helpers, frappe.utils.user and frappe.defaults.
- [Jobs, Cache and Realtime API](reference/python/jobs-cache-and-realtime.md): Signatures and behavior of frappe.enqueue, background job helpers, the scheduler, frappe.cache, caching decorators and frappe.publish_realtime.
- [Email, Files and Printing API](reference/python/email-files-and-printing.md): Signatures and behavior of frappe.sendmail, the email queue, Communication make, the File DocType, file endpoints, get_print, attach_print, get_pdf and Jinja rendering.
- [Testing API](reference/python/testing.md): Test classes, assertions, context managers, test record helpers and API test helpers in frappe.tests and frappe.test_runner, with their exact signatures and behavior.

### JavaScript API

- [frappe (JavaScript)](reference/javascript/frappe.md): Reference of the global frappe namespace in the v15 desk - server calls, messages, routing, realtime, boot, session, user, defaults, translation, metadata, toolbar and keyboard shortcuts.
- [Utils and Formatting (JavaScript)](reference/javascript/utils-and-formatting.md): Reference of client-side helpers in the v15 desk - frappe.utils, frappe.datetime, frappe.format, number and currency formatting, flt, cint, cstr, frappe.dom, frappe.urllib and other globals.
- [JavaScript Form API](reference/javascript/form.md): Reference for frappe.ui.form and the frm object in v15 desk JavaScript - form and child table events in trigger order, frm methods and properties, toolbar, dashboard, timeline, sidebar, ScriptManager, grid and quick entry.
- [JavaScript Model and DB API](reference/javascript/model-and-db.md): Reference for frappe.model, locals, frappe.db, frappe.model.user_settings, frappe.perm and frappe.workflow in the v15 desk JavaScript, with signatures, return values and side effects.
- [UI Components (JavaScript)](reference/javascript/ui-components.md): Reference of v15 desk UI classes - frappe.ui.Dialog, FieldGroup, MultiSelectDialog, Page, FileUploader, Capture, Scanner, Tags, Tree, Frappe Charts, notifications and the sidebar helper.
- [List and Report Views (JavaScript)](reference/javascript/list-and-report-views.md): Reference of the v15 client registries that customize desk views - listview_settings, ListView members, query_reports, calendar, gantt, tree, map, kanban, dashboard chart sources and number cards.

### HTTP API

- [REST Endpoints Reference](reference/http/rest-endpoints.md): Every route under /api in Frappe v15 (v1 and v2) and the most used whitelisted methods, with HTTP methods and permission checks.

### Configuration Reference

- [Hooks Reference](reference/configuration/hooks.md): Every hooks.py key that Frappe Framework v15 reads, with its shape, the file that reads it, and what it does.
- [Site Config Reference](reference/configuration/site-config.md): Every site_config.json and common_site_config.json key that Frappe Framework v15 reads, with its default and meaning.
- [CLI Reference](reference/configuration/cli.md): Every bench command that the frappe app provides in v15, with its options and whether it needs a site.

### Data Model Reference

- [Field Types](reference/data-model/field-types.md): Every DocField fieldtype with its database column type on MariaDB and Postgres, what Options means, and validation rules.
- [DocField Properties](reference/data-model/docfield-properties.md): Every DocField property from docfield.json with its type, default, the fieldtypes it applies to, its effect, and whether Customize Form and Custom Field can set it.
- [DocTypes Reference](reference/data-model/doctypes.md): Every DocType shipped with the frappe app, grouped by module, with flags and a one-line description.
